_comment: ABUTRON Own MCP Gateway V1 config — No OpenAI. Based on https://desktopcommander.app/mcp/#installation but hardened.

security.notes: Gateway never installs EX5 into active terminals, never changes CRM ON/OFF, never sends orders, never touches LIVE accounts. Staging only via reviewed abutron-ops workflow with hash-pin + offsite backup proof.

tls.recommended: Put behind Caddy/Nginx with Let's Encrypt or Tailscale Funnel — gateway itself binds localhost only, no public listener.
tls.alternative: Cloudflare Tunnel self-hosted (not OpenAI tunnel-client), WireGuard, or Tailscale Serve

vsLegacyOpenAI.legacy: ops/mcp_gateway: tunnel-client v0.0.20 + CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY + tunnel-id + Plus-blocked (Business/Enterprise only)
vsLegacyOpenAI.own: Zero OpenAI deps, zero Plus quota, own API key, works with Claude Desktop/Cursor/Windsurf/Any MCP SSE client
